extracted.intended_audience: authors, editors, and critics of short fiction; literate general readers interested in standards for evaluating short stories and collections
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and critical standards used to judge short stories and collections (style, characterization, plot, place, thematic depth, longevity, etc.), as exemplified in a 1918 critical yearbook summary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional quality
rubrics_metrics.description: “In this short story ... there is a fine emotional quality.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emotional resonance and a 'fine emotional quality' are positive attributes; the review cites works whose emotional tone elevates them (e.g., compares to author's best work).

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence from timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: “Written to assist the last Liberty Bond campaign, its significant interest is independent of its timeliness.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A story's value when it endures beyond topical or promotional purposes is a mark of quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deft characterization
rubrics_metrics.description: “These two novelettes are studies in national and temperamental contrasts. Their deft characterization ... entitle them to a place beside the best novels.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Skillful, nuanced portrayal of character types and contrasts; a decisive factor in ranking stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subtle humor
rubrics_metrics.description: “Their deft characterization, subtle humor, and sense of place ...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understated, fitting humor that complements characterization and setting contributes to excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sense of place
rubrics_metrics.description: Repeated praise for accurate depiction of locale: 'sense of place', 'pictorial value', 'unity of New England village life.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A convincing and evocative setting (regional or otherwise) that grounds the story and contributes to its unity and authenticity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disciplined sense of poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: “They reveal a disciplined sense of poetry ...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A controlled poetic sensibility in language and tone that enhances rather than overwhelms narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tolerance of outlook
rubrics_metrics.description: “... and a tolerance of outlook which spring from an older background ...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broad, empathetic perspective in characterization and theme is commended as a mark of maturity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Courage (in subject or treatment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories praised for 'qualities of courage, imagination, poetry, and dramatic irony.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Boldness in subject matter, viewpoint, or artistic choice is valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imagination
rubrics_metrics.description: Repeated mentions of 'imagination' and 'imaginative projection into a new world.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inventiveness in concept, scenario, or perspective—creating new or vividly realized imaginative spaces—earns high marks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Poetic quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Frequent reference to 'poetry' as a virtue (poetic studies in place, poetic interpretation of life).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A lyrical or elevated tone that enriches narrative voice and imagery contributes to a story's distinction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dramatic irony
rubrics_metrics.description: Valued feature: 'dramatic irony' among the 'old qualities' praised in certain war stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of irony that adds layers of meaning and emotional effect is highlighted as a strength.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thoughtful technique
rubrics_metrics.description: Praise for 'a more thoughtful technique' and 'conscientious technique.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conscious craft: structure, pacing, and formal choices that reflect deliberation and skill.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unerring sense of dramatic values
rubrics_metrics.description: “... a more unerring sense of dramatic values.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An instinct for what produces dramatic impact—selecting incidents, timing reveals, and emotional beats correctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meticulous attention to detail
rubrics_metrics.description: “With a meticulous attention to detail, and a keen eye for salient incident ...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Careful, telling details that illuminate character and situation strengthen realism and persuasive power.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy in use of material
rubrics_metrics.description: “Few writers show such economy in the use of their material.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise, efficient storytelling—using only what is necessary—improves artistic effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selective power (editing/selection)
rubrics_metrics.description: “The absence of selective power in many cases which often weakens his best work.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ability to choose and shape material (what to include/omit) is crucial; failure to select weakens the collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct sense of reality
rubrics_metrics.description: “Its effectiveness is due to its direct sense of reality ...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A convincing, immediate rendering of reality (psychological or physical) enhances reader engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incisive characterization
rubrics_metrics.description: “... and incisive characterization.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Penetrating, sharply observed character portrayals that reveal inner life and motive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity (of place or community)
rubrics_metrics.description: “These stories have the unity of New England village life.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coherence of setting and recurring themes/characters that create a unified vision across stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preservation of folk quality / appropriate register
rubrics_metrics.description: “Told in a simple style which preserves their folk quality without any attempt to refine upon it.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Matching style/register to source material (e.g., folk tales) and avoiding unnecessary 'refinement' that would betray the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding sentimentalization
rubrics_metrics.description: “Miss Ferber is at her best ... she has not sentimentalized her substance, but has accepted the sentimental values inherent in the theme and chronicled them faithfully.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledging sentiment without mawkishness—faithful chronicling rather than overwrought manipulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character individuality vs typification
rubrics_metrics.description: “In the best of these stories her characters are individualized; in those which are less successful they remain types.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer individualized, fully realized characters over flat archetypes or mere types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pictorial value / vivid imagery
rubrics_metrics.description: “Pictorial value which place them easily first among all imaginative records of the American desert.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strong visual imagery and scene-painting that give the work memorable pictures in the reader's mind.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prismatic beauty of phrasing / stylistic delicacy
rubrics_metrics.description: “Prismatic beauty of phrasing, which errs slightly on the side of preciosity.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attractive, finely wrought phrasing is praised, but excessive prettiness (preciosity) may be a flaw.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journalistic clarity with story values
rubrics_metrics.description: “It is not literature, but it is journalism at its very best, and has fine story values.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clear, reportorial prose can still possess storycraft (narrative shape and human interest); journalism can achieve high story values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conscientious accumulation of detail
rubrics_metrics.description: “... exact observation and conscientious accumulation of detail for which Mr. Dreiser is noted ...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliberate gathering of factual or observational detail can create authority and depth when balanced with selectivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understatement
rubrics_metrics.description: “Their effectiveness is largely due to the value of under statement.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restraint and suggestion often produce stronger effects than explicit statement; understatement as an aesthetic choice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mastery of plot and justifiable surprise endings
rubrics_metrics.description: “Few writers have so conscientious a technique as Mr. Post, or such a fine sense of plot. ... masterly examples of the justifiable surprise ending, yet have the logic and dramatic power ...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plot should be skillful, logically constructed, and conclusions (including surprise endings) must be earned and coherent with story logic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finality / artistic execution
rubrics_metrics.description: “Their imag[inative] reality, their warm color, and their finality of artistic execution.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A sense of artistic completeness—a finished quality in workmanship—confers lasting value on stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate balance between verse and prose
rubrics_metrics.description: Comment that prose sketches were good while the verse was very bad in a mixed volume.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In hybrid volumes, maintain appropriate quality across modes; inferior components (e.g., weak verse) can detract from overall value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conscious stylistic persona (voice)
rubrics_metrics.description: Remarks like 'a conscious stylist who never falls into preciosity' and praise for a writer who 'knows how to talk.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A distinctive, controlled authorial voice or persona is desirable so long as it serves the material and avoids affectation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suitability for intended audience / pedagogic usefulness
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments on collections 'edited for college and high school use' and whether selections are 'specially adapted to younger readers.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider whether the selection and presentation serve the needs of a targeted readership (educational or general).

rubrics_metrics.name: Representative selection of classics / canonical inclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessments noting whether collections are 'representative of the best ghost stories' or missing canonical pieces (Poe, de Maupassant, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anthologies are judged by comprehensiveness and inclusion of essential exemplars of the form.
